# SlimefunAdvancements 1.0.3

A Legacy-focused reliability release for modern Paper servers.

- Protects player advancement progress from partial/corrupted writes using atomic file replacement.
- Preserves last-known-good backups and can quarantine malformed or NUL-filled progress files for safe recovery.
- Hardens concurrent progress saves so multiple updates cannot corrupt the same player file.
- Retains the duplicate-registration fix without calling `Bukkit.reloadData()`, preserving Slimefun runtime recipes.
- Includes the newer guide-history safety fix used by JustEnoughGuide integration.
- CI now validates the release on Paper 26.2 / Java 25 directly against Slimefun Legacy while keeping Java 21 plugin bytecode.
